mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: When monthly PAYEMS crosses above 145,000 persons, indicating strong labor demand, this triggers positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: If returns are not positive when PAYEMS crosses above 145,000, or in >60% of triggered instances returns are not significant (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous monthly growth in GDPC1 (demand) and INDPRO (supply) signals economic expansion, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: both GDPC1 and INDPRO increase in the same month
failure_condition: If returns are not positive when both proxies increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'late-cycle expansion regime', a sustained decline in FEDFUNDS below 1.0% triggers positive 20-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If FEDFUNDS does not decline below 1.0% in late-cycle regime, or returns are not positive (p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained quarterly increase in GDPC1 (demand) over the last 5 trading days predicts positive returns over the next 5 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 increased in the last quarter
failure_condition: If GDPC1's increase does not precede positive returns, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 1-month window.

mechanism_narrative: When INDPRO crosses above 105, indicating supply growth, this triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 forward returns.
failure_condition: If returns are not positive when INDPRO crosses above 105, or in >50% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous rise in PAYEMS (labor) and GDPC1 (demand) signals strong labor demand and economic expansion, leading to positive returns over 20 days.
candidate_trigger: both PAYEMS and GDPC1 increase in the same month
failure_condition: If returns are not positive when both proxies increase, or Rank IC < 0.03 over 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In a 'low unemployment regime' (UNRATE <4%), a rise in PAYEMS above 145,000 persons triggers positive 60-day S&P 500 returns.
failure_condition: If in low unemployment regime, PAYEMS does not exceed 145,000 or returns are not positive (p > 0.05).
